claims.text: Originally a pair within the Wadjet Hall; the northern obelisk remains standing.
Hatshepsut erected rose-granite obelisks associated with her jubilee. The pair must be distinguished from other obelisk pairs at Karnak.
The obelisk texts refer to the jubilee of regnal year 16. No translation is supplied here.
Enclosure of the bases is traditionally assigned to Thutmose III, but a revised chronology proposes Hatshepsut herself. Do not present concealment from personal hatred as fact.

caveats: Present access, exact viewpoints and condition have not been field-verified.
